description_en: Queries the associate relationships of an automatic snapshot policy
description_zh: 查询自动快照策略的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-auto-snapshot-policy-associations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp12quk7gqhhuu1f0000 --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call DescribeRegions (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describeregions) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略所属的地域 ID。您可以调用 DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11) 查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.
You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照策略 ID。
AutoSnapshotPolicyId 和 DiskId 只能指定一个
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk ID.
You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId
parameters.help_zh:
云盘 ID。
AutoSnapshotPolicyId 和 DiskId 只能指定一个
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的`NextToken`参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:
When no value is set or the value is set to less than 10, the default value is 10.
When the value is set to greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。

默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 10 时，默认值为 10。
当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值
